# Individual-core historical oracles

These descriptors document old batch-named local runs that are still useful as
read-only comparison evidence for an individual core. Active contract modules,
pins, manifests, run IDs, and lifecycle records remain core-named.

An oracle descriptor may record positive historical output and rejected
comparison output. A historical run marked as rejected comparison evidence may
have completed successfully at the time; the rejection means its policy or
bytes are not admissible for the current individual-core lifecycle.

Never add a new run with a tranche name. New selected and reproduction builds
must use semantic core-owned run IDs.
